sections.title: Summary
paragraphs: For São Bento do Una, with medium soil and rainfed farming, the crops with the best simulated planting windows are: Cowpea, Peanut, Grain sorghum.

sections.title: Top crops
paragraphs: 1. Cowpea: The best window is Mar 11 – Jun 30, where planting succeeded in 89% of simulated seasons on average. The official ZARC window is shown on the chart for comparison. Confidence is medium: The engine's best dekad (Apr 21–30) is inside the ZARC window, but not in its best class.

2. Peanut: The best window is Mar 1 – Jun 20, where planting succeeded in 85% of simulated seasons on average. The official ZARC window is shown on the chart for comparison. Confidence is high: The engine's best dekad (Mar 21–31) is in ZARC's best class (value 20).

3. Grain sorghum: The best window is Mar 1 – Jun 20, where planting succeeded in 89% of simulated seasons on average. The official ZARC window is shown on the chart for comparison. Confidence is high: The engine's best dekad (Mar 21–31) is in ZARC's best class (value 20).

sections.title: How sure is this
paragraphs: These are probabilities from past seasons of NASA climate data, not a forecast. They describe a climate cell, not your field.
This is decision support: it does not replace your own judgement.

field_checks: Get a soil analysis: texture, depth and fertility change how much water the crop can use.
Check local market prices and buyers before choosing a crop.
Ask about pests and diseases this season with your local extension office.
Compare with the local planting calendar and your own experience of the rains.
